Apple TV today announced Guilty Creatures, a new thriller series based on Mikita Brottman’s true-crime book of the same name. Here are the details.

Apple TV announces new thriller ‘Guilty Creatures’

In a press release published today, Apple announced that Julia Garner (Ozark, Weapons) will star in Guilty Creatures, a new thriller series based on Mikita Brottman’s book, ‘Guilty Creatures: Sex, God, and Murder in Tallahassee, Florida.’

Here’s Apple on what to expect from the upcoming show:

Apple TV’s adaptation of Guilty Creatures will be directed by Craig Gillespie (I, Tonya, Pam & Tommy), who has also directed episodes of another Apple TV show, Your Friends & Neighbors. According to the company, “Stuart Zicherman (The Shrink Next Door, Sweetbitter, The Americans) will serve as showrunner and executive producer on the series, which is adapted for the screen by Sarah DeLappe (Bodies Bodies Bodies).”

In addition to starring, Garner will serve as an executive producer on the series. Apple has not announced a premiere date, but with the project now official, more casting news will likely follow in the coming weeks and months.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month and features hit TV shows and movies like Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking and Silo.
